# UsingInclusionReturnValue

<Badge type="info" text="info" /> <Badge type="info" text="off by default" /> 

Group: [Code style](/rules/#code-style) · PhpStorm name: `UsingInclusionReturnValueInspection`

Using the value produced by `include`/`require` (a file that `return`s
something) couples code to file layout and hides dependencies. Prefer explicit
objects or functions; inclusion should be a standalone statement.

## Example

```php{6,7,8,9,12}
<?php
require_once __DIR__ . '/bootstrap.php';
include('helpers.php');

function settings(array $env) {
    $base = require __DIR__ . '/base.php';
    merge(include_once 'extra.php');
    $env['db'] = require_once('db.php');
    if (true !== include 'optional.php') {
        log_missing();
    }
    return include('defaults.php');
}
```

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 6: Avoid relying on the value returned by an included file.</li>
<li>line 7: Avoid relying on the value returned by an included file.</li>
<li>line 8: Avoid relying on the value returned by an included file.</li>
<li>line 9: Avoid relying on the value returned by an included file.</li>
<li>line 12: Avoid relying on the value returned by an included file.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "UsingInclusionReturnValue": {
      "enabled": true
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore UsingInclusionReturnValue

/**
 * @noinspection UsingInclusionReturnValueInspection
 */
```
